FULL TEXT:
No: DBT/2026/PC
Date: 06-10-2026
Advertisement Notice
Applications are invited from interested and eligible candidates for a walk-in interview for a Project Assistant
position in a research project funded by Department of Biotechnology, Ministry of Science and technology,
Government of India. The details are as follows:
Title of the Project: Exploring the Role of TGF- pseudo receptor BAMBI-driven Androgen Deprivation
Therapy-Induced Muscle Wasting in Prostate Cancer Cachexia
Position Essential Qualifications Monthly Emoluments
Project Assistant M.Sc Biochemistry /Biotechnology /Nanotechnology
and other allied subjects with a minimum 55% marks.
Candidates with NET/SET or GATE shall be preferred.
20000 + 18 % HRA
The interview details are as below:
Date: 19.10.2026 (Monday)
Time: 2:30 PM
Venue: Department of Nanotechnology,
CCPC, University of Kashmir
The position is purely temporary and co-terminus with the end of the project and is subject to the
release of funds. Interested candidates may email the statement of interest, along with qualification,
age, experience certificate as a single PDF file to beighm@uok.edu.in by or before 16-10-2026.
Sd/-
Mushtaq A Beigh, PhD
(Principal Investigator)
DEPARTMENT OF NANOTECHNOLOGY
UNIVERSITY OF KASHMIR, SRINAGAR
(NAAC Accredited Grade – A)
